about: Targets QuestionAgent (question_gate@v1 + question_agent@v1) must reach on question_golden.json, over surfaced suggestions only: ask_rate (useful / surfaced, the Ask-rate proxy), gap_recall (gaps addressed / gaps) and noise_rate (no-gap windows with a surfaced suggestion). Measured on the first live run after triage calls ran with thinking disabled. Each bound allows one case of run-to-run variance (7 gap windows, 7 no-gap windows): a new prompt must at least match them.
